name: Congenital Talipes Equinovarus / Clubfoot
definition: Congenital foot deformity characterized by cavus, adductus, varus and equinus, usually treated early with serial manipulation and casting.

investigations.principle: Diagnosis is clinical; imaging is rarely required in typical infant clubfoot.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, physeal, occult injury, deformity or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific diagnostic pathway.

green: Bracing after correction to prevent relapse
amber: Relapse is common without brace adherence; resistant or atypical cases need pediatric orthopedic review.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Pada congenital deformity may be documented only in parallel.

patientEducation.summary: Congenital foot deformity characterized by cavus, adductus, varus and equinus, usually treated early with serial manipulation and casting.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute neurovascular compromise, major trauma, open injury, severe deformity, rapidly progressive neurological symptoms, suspected infection or other listed red flags.
